text: seyyathīdaṃ . sammādiṭṭhi .pe. sammāsamādhi . idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave brahmaññaṃ . [110] katamo ca bhikkhave brahmaññattho . yo ca 2 bhikkhave rāgakkhayo dosakkhayo mohakkhayo . ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave brahmaññatthoti . [111] sāvatthīnidānaṃ . brahmacariyañca vo bhikkhave desissāmi brahmacariyaphalāni ca taṃ suṇātha . [112] katamañca bhikkhave brahmacariyaṃ . ayamevāriyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo . seyyathīdaṃ . sammādiṭṭhi .pe. sammāsamādhi . idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave brahmacariyaṃ . #1-2 ma. yu. kho .
